stemMd: For which values of $c$ does $x^2+6x+c=0$ have no real solutions?
explanationMd: The discriminant is 36−4c. No real roots require 36−4c<0, hence c>9. Equivalently, (x+3)²=9−c cannot equal a negative value.

distractorRationale.c: At c=9 there is one real root, so equality must be excluded.
distractorRationale.a: This forgets the factor 4 multiplying c in the discriminant.
distractorRationale.d: That makes the discriminant positive and gives two real roots.
